lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 15 visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Centroids exhibit regular spatial distribution along the mid-lateral axis, forming a grid-like pattern with vertical and horizontal alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal carinae and secondary horizontal stripes. High-intensity circular blobs are precisely centered at these grid intersections across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the superior third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient showing high luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes consistent with commensal Echeneidae (remoras) trailing beneath the pectoral fin and ventral midline.
